name: Netlify
tagline: Netlify is a web development platform that automates the deployment of modern web apps with features including CI/CD, serverless functions, edge computing, and form handling. Its AI features include AI-assisted local development guidance, intelligent build caching, and integration with the Netlify AI assistant for configuration help.
